description: Source code for Spark Streaming checkpoint management, including classes and objects for checkpoint creation, serialization, deserialization, reading, writing, and checkpoint file handling.

classes.name: Checkpoint
classes.description: Represents a Spark Streaming checkpoint, including validation and serialization methods.

classes.name: CheckpointWriter
classes.description: Handles asynchronous writing of checkpoint data to files with retries.

classes.name: CheckpointReader
classes.description: Reads checkpoint data from files, deserializing checkpoint objects.

classes.name: ObjectInputStreamWithLoader
classes.description: Custom ObjectInputStream that resolves classes using a specified ClassLoader.

methods.name: createSparkConf
methods.description: Creates a SparkConf object with properties reloaded from checkpoint context.

methods.name: checkpointFile
methods.description: Returns the Path for a checkpoint file for a given checkpoint time.

methods.name: checkpointBackupFile
methods.description: Returns the Path for a backup checkpoint file.

methods.name: getCheckpointFiles
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts checkpoint files from a directory.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Checkpoint object into a byte array with compression.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a Checkpoint object from an InputStream with decompression.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads checkpoint files from a directory, returning the latest valid checkpoint.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Queues a checkpoint for asynchronous writing to storage.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the checkpoint writer executor.
